title: Fixed #35331 -- Updated dropdown lists with new entries added via the "+" sign from M2M field.
description:
# Trac ticket number
ticket-35331

# Branch description
When adding a new related entry on a filter horizontal vie the "+" sign from an M2M field, it used to not updated related fields. Now we call `UpdateRelatedSelectOptions` for all related fields except the `from` box. This also introduces a fix to ensure that the cache always accounts for items inside the selectBox so that they may be moved without requiring a refresh.
commit_message: Fixed #35331 -- Updated dropdown lists with entries added via the '+' sign from M2M field.
author: Devin Cox
